name: Editorial, Publishing & Portfolio

designIntent.primaryGoal: Make long-form content and authored work memorable, readable and easy to navigate.
designIntent.visualThesis: Typography, imagery and composition establish the voice; interface controls stay quiet.

visualDirection.density: low for featured storytelling; medium for archives and indexes
visualDirection.surfaces: minimal framing, selective rules and whitespace
visualDirection.colorIntent: restrained palette with strong foreground/background pairing; links remain identifiable
visualDirection.typography: display face may contrast with body face; prioritize long-form readability and language glyph support
visualDirection.motion: subtle transitions; avoid slowing reading or navigation

layout.pattern: editorial masthead + featured content + archive/list; portfolio may use a curated project index
layout.spacing: comfortable line length and vertical rhythm
layout.responsive: preserve reading measure and image crop intent across widths

avoid: decorative UI competing with the content

accessibility.keyboard: navigation and archive filters remain keyboard accessible
accessibility.reducedMotion: avoid parallax or animated text that disrupts reading

antiPatterns: headline as the only accessible label
notes: A portfolio should show the author's actual work and role. Never invent projects or outcomes.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Discover a story or body of work → understand authorship and context → read or inspect → explore related work.
prioritize: The authored work itself and its context
Typography and content hierarchy suited to the reading task
Author, date, role, credits and related material when known
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Authorship, publication date, project role and image rights
Whether portfolio claims and outcomes are substantiated
Language, reading direction and long-form requirements
avoidByDefault: Huge hero copy displacing the work
Invented client logos, awards, outcomes or bylines
acceptanceChecks: Body text remains comfortable at narrow and wide widths
Images have contextual alternatives or appropriate decorative treatment

compositionEscapes.when: Readers need to browse many stories, projects or archive entries.
compositionEscapes.composition: Make a typographic index, category list or carefully ordered archive primary; feature one selected item only when editorial priority is real.
contentRequirements: Real titles, categories, authors or dates
avoid: Generic hero plus identical card grid

compositionEscapes.when: One article, essay or long-form story is the primary task.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a focused title/byline/metadata block followed by a readable column, placing figures, contents and related stories where they support comprehension.
contentRequirements: Figure captions and sources where needed
avoid: Too many side panels beside text

compositionEscapes.when: The goal is to evaluate a creator's actual projects, skills and contribution.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a curated work index leading into case studies; explain each brief, individual role, constraints, decisions and verifiable result.
contentRequirements: Real projects and accurate role attribution
avoid: Project cards with no work context
Attributing team results to one person
